meta.title: cv.cm — browser tools, nothing uploaded
meta.description: Free tools that run in your browser. Add watermarks to images without uploading files. No account, no database.

home.title: A collection of in-browser tools
home.lead: cv.cm offers tools that run in your browser. No sign-up. Files are not uploaded to a server.

local.title: On-device
local.body: Processing uses your browser canvas. Files never leave this tab.

nodb.title: No database
nodb.body: No accounts, no cloud folders, no file history. Closing the tab discards everything.

i18n.title: Languages
i18n.body: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, Español.

watermark.name: Image watermark
watermark.blurb: Stamp text or a logo onto photos. Batch export as PNG, JPEG, or ZIP. Nothing is uploaded.

collage.name: Photo collage
collage.blurb: Combine photos into one picture. Pick a layout, spacing, and export. Nothing is uploaded.
